title: Termwise Picard models and their canonical pullback comparisons
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq W$ an open, and $K$ a cochain complex of modules on its open site [def-pc-derived-category]. For $s:T\to U$ let $P_s=s^*(\operatorname{overEquiv}(U)K)$, applying tensor pullback term by term. For $t:T\to W$ let $A_t=(t^*\mathcal O_W)[0]$. If $i:T\prime\to T$, $i;t=t\prime$ and $i;s=s\prime$, define $u:A_{t\prime}\cong i^*A_t$ by the single-complex comparison and the adjunction-mate composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], and $w:P_{s\prime}\cong i^*P_s$ by the termwise composition isomorphism. With derived localizations fixed, define $\eta_i:Li^*Q\to Q i^*$ by transporting the homotopy counit pinned by [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] across the quotient comparison. These are explicit constructions; no flatness, connectivity, or representing-object hypothesis is imposed. Derived pullback is that of [def-pc-derived-pullback].
